map.稀释按定容到 V2，不是 V1+加水量等于 V2（浓溶液有体积收缩）；以终体积为: Dilution means making up to V2, not V1 plus the water added equalling V2, since concentrated solutions contract; use the final volume.

map.浓度各自单位一致、体积各自单位一致即可，结果才准确。: The concentrations need consistent units among themselves and so do the volumes, otherwise the result will be wrong.
